facts.fact: HoA DRIVE reports that satellite monitoring of vegetation triggered drought Takaful payouts in Hiiraan, Galguduud, Lower Shabelle, Bay and Middle Shabelle under the World Bank-financed Index-Based Livestock Takaful programme, supported by the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Livestock, Forestry and Range, with ACRE Africa calculating payouts from satellite data.

HoA DRIVE reports 17,373 pastoralists received US$3.43 million in September 2026 payouts triggered by satellite vegetation monitoring, after an earlier round in March 2026 reaching about 17,734 pastoralists.

systems.platform: HoA DRIVE (World Bank-financed); ACRE Africa satellite data; ZEP-RE
systems.owner: Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Livestock, Forestry and Range
